QuestInfo.name: [Carcion] Pinjar Search
QuestInfo.0: The island is crawling with the Flora Army's minions, while the island's Anima inhabitants are nowhere in sight. Track down the Turtle Anima in #bPinjar#k, on Carcion's outskirts.
QuestInfo.1: Move across Pinjar and suppress any nearby enemies.
QuestInfo.2: While searching Pinjar, you found the #bTurtle Anima#k in battle with a group of Specters. You saved them, but found that many of the Anima were infected with the High Flora's curse, the same curse that seems to be infecting Carcion's native creatures.

0.msg: The enemy occupies not only the main river, but its tributaries as well. Drive them out of Pinjar.
